findings.title: [P2] Validate replacement speech before retiring active playback
findings.body: `Retire()` cancels the current operation before `RequireAccess` and text-length validation run. Consequently, an empty or oversized replacement request cancels valid speech even though the replacement is rejected without synthesis. Validate these admission conditions before retiring the active operation, so rejected calls leave existing playback intact.

findings.title: [P2] Show the transmission disclosure before enabling Gateway voice
findings.body: The disclosure is inside a panel that remains collapsed until Gateway voice is enabled. For users who already have automatic read-aloud enabled, turning on this toggle immediately authorizes subsequent replies to be sent to the Gateway's speech provider before the additional data sharing has been explained. Keep the transmission disclosure visible while the toggle is off so users can make an informed choice before enabling it.
